biggest_catch: Your friend must deposit $5,000+ of external funds within 15 days AND leave it untouched for 90 days — and your $100 arrives within 60 days after that, so the payout can take up to ~5.5 months after your friend opens. Cap is $500/year.
catches: $100 per successful referral, up to $500 per calendar year (5 referrals).
Friend must deposit $5,000 or more of external funds within 15 days of account opening, then maintain those funds for a 90-day holding period; falling below the threshold can void the bonus.
Your $100 is added within 60 days after your friend completes the 90-day holding period — total wait up to ~165 days after account opening.

Eligibility is account-based: if you don't see a 'Copy referral code' button on the referrals page, your account isn't currently eligible or the program isn't active at that moment (not a personal invitation — eligibility varies by account type, activity, and status).
Your friend's own welcome bonus is tiered ($75-$1,500 by deposit size), but your referrer bonus is a flat $100 regardless.

steps: Copy your unique 360 Performance Savings referral code from the referrals page (you must be logged in to a referral-eligible account).
Share the code with friends and family.
Each friend opens a new 360 Performance Savings account with your code, deposits $5,000+ of external funds within 15 days, and maintains those funds for 90 days.
You receive $100 per qualifying friend within 60 days after their 90-day holding period ends (up to $500/year).
timing: $100 added to your account within 60 days after the friend completes the required 90-day holding period.
